items.title: Maps from a truncation into an n-type correspond to maps from the original type into it
items.author: The Univalent Foundations Program

items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author labelled lemma at source lines 541-546: the universal property of truncation, that maps from the truncation of A into an n-truncated type are the maps from A. The proof (source lines 548-552) is short but it is a construction with both checks rather than a pointer: it extends a map by the recursion principle for truncations, then shows that the extension composed with the projection returns the original map on every point, and that extending a composite returns the same map by comparing the two on a generating projection. The construction and the two round-trip verifications are the substance, and the sequence of maps in the statement does not display them.
